title: The page export keeps all six collections append-only, so archived items survive a page cleanup
why: Coordinator 01:00 CST Nov 15 (relayed, not read by triage): the export mirror-deletes the other five collections (feedback_guard, export_page). After a page cleanup, which removes archived rows from the page database (ruling own-archive-off-page), the next export would then erase those archived items from waiting/ on the roadmap branch, the only copy. Make all six collections (items, answers, groups, asks, meta, receipts) append-only in the export: it adds and updates files and never deletes one. Separate PR from lane export-holds-every-record (step status-page-size-cap), ordered before any page cleanup: step 3 of the order in status-page-size-cap (remove archived rows from the page) waits for this step. Not set as blockedBy on that step, because that step is doing and its first two parts (export receipts, fresh copy) go on. Unread: which six names the shared list holds after the receipts change (ruling own-export-receipts-list-a), and where the mirror delete lives beyond the two files the coordinator named. Red first: a test that an export run with an emptied collection removes no file in waiting/.
source: Coordinator message 01:00 CST Nov 15 to triage (owner ask: none).
note: Filed 01:00 CST Nov 15 by triage fork. Tracker: the coordinator names the lane. Ordering: before the page cleanup in status-page-size-cap. No PR yet.
